youtube_description:
DiSK is a Digital Study Kit developed exclusively for Telangana Intermediate Students in association with Board of Intermediate Education, Telangana State.

Once Downloaded, works OFFLINE without Internet(Except for Video Lessons & Ask Feature).

DiSK is available for MPC, BiPC, CEC, MEC, HEC group Students in both Telugu and English Mediums.

Along with Board Exams, Students can prepare for Entrance Exams like JEE, EAMCET, NEET and CA-CPT.

DiSK is loaded with lot of exciting features, to provide classroom experience to students:

* Practice for all kind of Entrance Exams - JEE, Eamcet, NEET & CA-CPT * Unlimited Mock Tests & Practice * Test performance in Dashboard * Text Books with relevant syllabus & helps students to understand the subject in a better & robust way * Extensive range of Multiple Choice Questions enable students to practice MCQ's *  6000+ Videos with Unlimited Access * Students can talk to our experts for subject related support & assistance
